property_summary: For any owner-called transferAnyERC20Token with any token/recipient/amount, the call must never complete successfully while returning false: a well-behaved token yields success=true and a reverting token makes the call revert; the mutant breaks this by swallowing the outcome and completing with success=false for a succeeding token.
change_summary: Perform the transfer but set success to false instead of propagating the token call's return value.
